_doc: Brand definition for the Recipe Bank public site (site/): name, promise, voice, the layout contract and the facts ledger. Colour, type, spacing, radius and motion are not defined here any more: the site uses the dashboard's design tokens (docs/design/DESIGN.md), written out in css/site.css, and test/site.test.mjs checks them (contrast, the two dark blocks, the hero palette, and the dashboard's own stylesheet once the redesign is merged). What the site claims about features lives in data/features.json; publishing settings live in data/site.json.
title: Recipe Bank: turn recipe videos into exact ingredients and steps
one_line: Turn any recipe video into exact ingredients and steps.

primary_cta.label: Star and run it from GitHub

design._doc: Where the visual language comes from. The site adds only the tokens marked 'site only' in css/site.css.
design.tokens: docs/design/DESIGN.md (the dashboard's design contract), implemented in site/css/site.css
design.fonts: System fonts only. The dashboard's faces (Fraunces, Inter) are named first in the stacks, so a visitor who has them installed sees them; nothing is downloaded.
design.hero_palette: js/hero.js PALETTES: tile = --ink, accent = --accent of each theme.

voice.tone: Calm, specific, no hype. Says what the product does today and labels what is being merged and what is planned.
rules: Every claim comes from README.md, ROADMAP.md, CLAUDE.md, the code, or the documents of a branch that is being merged. Nothing else goes on a page.
A feature is named on the site only if it is in data/features.json with a status and a source.
No invented users, numbers, reviews, logos or deadlines.
No exclamation marks. No em or en dashes in page copy: use a full stop, a comma, a colon, or the word to.
Headings in two parts: a plain line, then the emphasis words in italics.

layout_contract.shell: html paints the page. Sticky full-bleed header, full-bleed bands whose inner container caps content with padding (1240 px, 1440 px from 1920), full-bleed footer.
layout_contract.nav: One nav in the header. Below 1280 px it is the header's second row and scrolls sideways inside itself; from 1280 px it sits inline. No script.
layout_contract.docs: Below 1280 px: one column with a Docs menu button (a plain list without JavaScript). From 1280 px: a sticky sidebar. From 1920 px: sidebar, text, and an 'on this page' column.
